title: Code-Graph RAG Custom Data Ingestion Schema
description: Standard schema for ingesting custom entities, relationships, and metadata into Memgraph + vector database. Fully backwards compatible with existing formats, supports optional incremental update operations.

metadata.description: Top-level metadata applied to all entities and relationships in this dataset

dataset_id.description: Required unique identifier for the entire dataset (used for deduplication and bulk deletion)

source.description: Optional source attribution for the data

created_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp of when the dataset was generated

default_entity_labels.description: Optional default labels to apply to all entities if no labels are specified on individual entities

operation.description: Optional default operation for all entities/relationships in this batch (overridden by per-entity/relationship operation values if present). Defaults to 'add' if not specified.

batch_id.description: Optional unique ID for this ingestion batch, used for audit tracking and idempotency guarantees

last_updated.description: Optional default last updated timestamp for all entities/relationships in this batch (overridden by per-entity/relationship timestamps if present), used for incremental update change detection

entities.description: List of graph nodes (entities) to ingest

id.description: Optional unique entity ID within the dataset (auto-generated if not provided)

name.description: Required human-readable name of the entity (used for deduplication if no ID is provided)

type.description: Optional primary type of the entity (used as a node label, merged with the labels array if provided)

labels.description: Optional list of labels to apply to the graph node (e.g. ['Job', 'Skill'])

operation.description: Optional operation for this specific entity, overrides batch-level default operation

last_updated.description: Optional last updated timestamp for this specific entity, overrides batch-level default timestamp

properties.description: Arbitrary key-value properties to attach to the graph node

description.description: Recommended default field used for embedding generation (used for semantic search)

relationships.description: List of graph relationships between entities, or object containing a 'relationships' array (compatible with your existing format)

source.description: Required source entity name or ID (matches entities[].name or entities[].id)

target.description: Required target entity name or ID (supports comma-separated multiple targets, e.g. 'Target 1, Target 2')

operation.description: Optional operation for this specific relationship, overrides batch-level default operation

last_updated.description: Optional last updated timestamp for this specific relationship, overrides batch-level default timestamp

confidence.description: Optional confidence score for the relationship (0-1), used for conflict resolution

explanation.description: Optional explanation for the relationship (used for relationship embedding generation if provided)

isInferred.description: Optional flag indicating if the relationship was inferred vs manually curated
